messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — we need a small migration pass for a) phrase tone tweaks (remove 'please' in API errors), b) parameter naming in SDK snippets (snake_case -> lowerCamelCase), and c) a short glossary entry for 'rollout policy'.

sam: +1. Can we scope this to only pages that ship with SDK snippets? I can take SDK PRs. :+1:

kevin: I can audit all error messages in the HTTP API reference. Do we have a canonical list of phrases to change?

jess: Great. Draft rules: 1) avoid "please" in error/UI text, 2) prefer active voice, 3) param names in SDK samples must match SDK surface (lowerCamelCase for JS, snake_case for Python examples), 4) add glossary line for "rollout policy": "rules that control model selection and fallback behavior during deploys."

maria: Re: (3) — do we want to keep separate code blocks for each language or show one canonical example and call out differences?

sam: Prefer separate blocks, short. Example for JS + Python. That prevents copy-paste bugs.

kevin: I'll run a grep of the repo for common phrases; expect a small PR from me by EOD.

jess: Thanks. For tracking: 1) sdk-snippets branch -> PR against docs main 2) docs team will review tone changes 3) eng-runtime to sign off on any behavioral glossary updates.

docs-bot: Reminder: new PR template item added: "Confirm code example naming matches SDK surface (link to style guide)". See https://redwood.example.dev/docs/style-guide#sdk-snippets

maria: Example snippet to use in the migration guide: ```js
// JS example (use in docs)
const response = await client.generate({
  model: "rwdx-7b",
  prompt: "Summarize...",
  maxTokens: 512
});
```

maria: And Python: ```py
# Python example (use in docs)
response = client.generate(model="rwdx-7b", prompt="Summarize...", max_tokens=512)
```

sam: Awesome — I'll make the SDK PR that swaps code blocks and updates param casing. Tagging @kevin for the error text sweep.

kevin: Tagged. Quick note: when changing wording in error strings, keep machine-readable keys unchanged. Only user-facing message text should change.

jess: Good call. Also add a one-paragraph migration note in the docs index: "SDK snippet casing update (Mar 2026) — see migration notes" so customers searching copies find it.

docs-bot: Created tracking ticket DOCS-4421 (migration pass) and linked PR template.

maria: ETA for copy PR review? I can review tomorrow morning.

sam: I plan to open PR in ~3 hours. Assign to @maria + @jess.

jess: Perfect. After reviews we'll run a small search-and-replace with a review step (no mass automated rewrites). Keep changes small, per-file.

kevin: I'll post the grep results here when ready.

jess: Thanks team — quick, surgical pass. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
